report.summary: The Nova delivery ledger for the period 2026Q1-2026Q3 contains a sample ledger that exposes the eligible cohort of approved Nova sample records, including both on-time orders and committed orders, which can be used to calculate the weighted on-time delivery metric as sum(on_time_orders) / sum(committed_orders).
